question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Initially'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the paragraph, we have discussed the life of Shakespeare.
 
• Only** option 2 **that is **initially** best suits the line: **"Initially, Shakespeare became an actor."**
 
• The word **initially** means **'to start with'**.

**The correct sentence__**:** *****Initially**, Shakespeare became an actor.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• The word **primitively** means **'basic'**.
 
• The word **firstly** means **'****in the first place'**. 
 
• The word **first of all** means **'****most importantly'**.
